en: Actions are (judged) by motives (niyyah), so each man will have what he intended.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #1 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: Islam has been built on five : testifying that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing the salah (prayer), paying the zakat (obligatory charity), making the hajj (pilgrimage) to the House, and fasting in Ramadhan.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #3 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: That which is lawful is clear and that which is unlawful is clear, and between the two of them are doubtful matters about which many people do not know. Thus he who avoids doubtful matters clears himself in regard to his religion and his honor.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #6 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: “The deen (religion) is naseehah (advice, sincerity).” We said, “To whom?” He (ﷺ) said, “To Allah, His Book, His Messenger, and to the leaders of the Muslims and their common folk.”
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #7 · Muslim · Sahih

en: Part of the perfection of one’s Islam is his leaving that which does not concern him.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #12 · Tirmidhi & others · Hasan

en: None of you believes until he loves for his brother that which he loves for himself.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #13 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: Let him who believes in Allah and the Last Day speak good, or keep silent.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #15 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: Verily Allah has prescribed ihsan (proficiency, perfection) in all things. So if you kill then kill well; and if you slaughter, then slaughter well. Let each one of you sharpen his blade and let him spare suffering to the animal he slaughters.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #17 · Muslim · Sahih

en: Have taqwa (fear) of Allah wherever you may be, and follow up a bad deed with a good deed which will wipe it out, and behave well towards the people.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #18 · Tirmidhi · Hasan

en: If you feel no shame, then do as you wish.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #20 · Bukhari · Sahih

en: Purity is half of iman (faith). ‘Al-hamdu lillah (praise be to Allah)’ fills the scales, and ‘subhan-Allah (how far is Allah from every imperfection) and ‘Al-hamdulillah (praise be to Allah)’ fill that which is between heaven and earth.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #23 · Muslim · Sahih

en: Every joint of a person must perform a charity.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #26 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: Righteousness is in good character, and wrongdoing is that which wavers in your soul, and which you dislike people finding out about.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #27 · Muslim · Sahih

en: There should be neither harming (darar) nor reciprocating harm (dirar)
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #32 · Ibn Majah & others · Hasan

en: Whosoever of you sees an evil, let him change it with his hand; and if he is not able to do so, then with his tongue; and if he is not able to do so, then with his heart — and that is the weakest of faith.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #34 · Muslim · Sahih

en: Whoever removes a worldly grief from a believer, Allah will remove from him one of the griefs of the Day of Resurrection. And whoever alleviates the need of a needy person, Allah will alleviate his needs in this world and the Hereafter.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #36 · Muslim · Sahih

en: Verily Allah has pardoned for me my ummah: their mistakes, their forgetfulness, and that which they have been forced to do under duress.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #39 · Ibn Majah & al-Bayhaqi · Hasan

en: Be in this world as though you were a stranger or a wayfarer.
src: Hadith · An-Nawawi’s Forty #40 · Bukhari · Sahih

en: When Allah decreed the Creation He pledged Himself by writing in His book which is laid down with Him: My mercy prevails over my wrath.
src: Hadith · Hadith Qudsi (Forty) #1 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih Qudsi

en: I am so self-sufficient that I am in no need of having an associate. Thus he who does an action for someone else's sake as well as Mine will have that action renounced by Me to him whom he associated with Me.
src: Hadith · Hadith Qudsi (Forty) #5 · Muslim · Sahih Qudsi

en: The first of his actions for which a servant of Allah will be held accountable on the Day of Resurrection will be his prayers. If they are in order, then he will have prospered and succeeded: and if they are wanting, then he will have failed and lost.
src: Hadith · Hadith Qudsi (Forty) #9 · Tirmidhi · Sahih Qudsi

en: Spend (on charity), O son of Adam, and I shall spend on you.
src: Hadith · Hadith Qudsi (Forty) #11 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih Qudsi

en: I am as My servant thinks I am. I am with him when he makes mention of Me. If he makes mention of Me to himself, I make mention of him to Myself; and if he makes mention of Me in an assembly, I make mention of him in an assembly better than it.
src: Hadith · Hadith Qudsi (Forty) #15 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih Qudsi

en: Pride is my cloak and greatness My robe, and he who competes with Me in respect of either of them I shall cast into Hell-fire.
src: Hadith · Hadith Qudsi (Forty) #19 · Muslim · Sahih Qudsi

en: Where are those who love one another through My glory? Today I shall give them shade in My shade, it being a day when there is no shade but My shade.
src: Hadith · Hadith Qudsi (Forty) #23 · Muslim · Sahih Qudsi

en: Whosoever shows enmity to someone devoted to Me, I shall be at war with him. My servant draws not near to Me with anything more loved by Me than the religious duties I have enjoined upon him.
src: Hadith · Hadith Qudsi (Forty) #25 · Bukhari · Sahih Qudsi

en: If My servant likes to meet Me, I like to meet him; and if he dislikes to meet Me, I dislike to meet him.
src: Hadith · Hadith Qudsi (Forty) #30 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih Qudsi

en: I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen and no ear has heard, not has it occurred to human heart.
src: Hadith · Hadith Qudsi (Forty) #37 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih Qudsi

en: War is deception.
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #2 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: Someone whose advice is sought is in a position of trust.
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #4 · Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi · Sahih

en: The person guiding (someone) to do a good deed, is like the one performing the good deed.
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #5 · Muslim · Sahih

en: Protect yourself from the fire even with a part of a date.
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #7 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: The world is the believer’s prison and the disbeliever’s paradise.
ar: الدُّنْیَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤمِنِ وَ جَنَّةُ الْکَافِرِ
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #8 · Muslim · Sahih

en: Modesty is entirely good.
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #9 · Muslim · Sahih

en: Richness lies in the richness of the soul.
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #17 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: A man will be with whom he loves.
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #21 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: The child belongs to the bed and stoning is for the adulterer.
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #23 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: The upper hand is superior to the lower hand.
ar: الْیَدُ الْعُلْیَا خَیْرٌ مِّنَ الْیَدِ السُّفْلَی
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #24 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: He does not thank Allah who does not thank people.
ar: لَا شَکَرَ اللهَ مَنْ لَّا یَشْکُرُ النَّاسَ
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #25 · Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi · Sahih

en: Whoever is killed attempting to save his property is a martyr.
ar: مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِیْدٌ
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #32 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: Actions are through intentions.
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #33 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: Travelling is a portion of punishment.
src: Hadith · Shah Waliullah’s Forty #38 · Bukhari & Muslim · Sahih

en: The gates of Paradise are opened on Mondays and Thursdays, and every servant who associates nothing with Allah is forgiven, except a man who has enmity between himself and his brother.
src: Hadith · Hadith Qudsi (Forty) #20 · Muslim · Sahih
